snippet.title: Canvas City - Official Demo Reveal Trailer | The MIX Summer Game Showcase 2026
snippet.description: Check out the Demo Reveal Trailer for Canvas City, a turn-based tactics RPG developed by Disc 2 Games. Players will lead a crew of skaters and street artists rising up against an oppressive regime. Each map is a battleground and a canvas, where your actions shift control, leave your mark, and shape the city’s future. Canvas City is coming soon to Nintendo Switch and PC (Steam), with a demo coming soon.
